Footer.description: HeartRateTap estimates BPM from the timing of taps you make while feeling your pulse. It does not sense your heartbeat and is not a medical device. Recent measurements stay in this browser by default.
Footer.emergency: If you have chest pain, shortness of breath, fainting or another urgent symptom, contact local emergency services; do not wait for or rely on this website.
